snippet.title: Waltz of the Wizard | Screen Mode Gameplay Trailer | PC Steam | PS5
snippet.description:
Waltz of the Wizard, the classic VR wizard simulator, can now be played on a screen on Steam for PC, Steam Deck and PS5 with Screen Mode!

STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1094390/Waltz_of_the_Wizard/

PLAYSTATION 5:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10007299

Delve into a meticulously crafted world inspired classical fantasy fiction, greatly expanded with major updates since the original release. Waltz of the Wizard includes hours of content, thrilling gameplay, humorous characters, and many curious secrets. Your journey begins in a magical tower where you combine arcane ingredients into a boiling cauldron with the help of your torturable skull assistant and embark on an absurdly mysterious adventure beyond the tower.
 
Key features:
🧙‍♂️ Unleash dozens of extraordinary magic abilities, each bending the laws of physics in thrilling and powerful ways.
🔍 Discover absurdly detailed secrets in every corner of your tower.
📜 Large campaign with storyline, combat and challenges.
🎙️ Hundreds of voice interactions.
💍 Incredible voice powers that can be used on everything.
🏰 Infinite level generation mode for endless fun in the Fortress dungeon crawling.
👥 Team up with a friend in asymmetric co-op.
💀 Chat with, juggle or torture Skully your skull assistant, imagination is the only limit
